one_line: Ritual king of Puri who humbly sweeps Lord Jagannath’s chariot as the deity’s foremost servant.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, athletic but not heavily muscular, with a poised royal bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium-brown Odia complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm serious eyes with a gentle humility, default expression a composed half-smile that mixes royal authority with devotional softness.
appearance.hair: Black hair tied in a short, neat topknot at the back of the head, sides and nape closely trimmed, front kept smooth; a finely embroidered cream-and-gold turban (odisha-style pagri) wrapped low with a small central gold ornament shaped like a lotus at the forehead.
appearance.costume: A long, knee-length cream-coloured cotton angarkha-style tunic with wrapped front and side-ties, edged with narrow red borders and subtle woven diamond motifs, worn over a deep-red silk dhoti (pancha) pleated in front and wrapped securely to the ankles, bordered in gold; a broad golden-yellow silk uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the torso and falling over the right arm, its edges decorated with simple maroon floral patterns; on his feet, brown leather mojari-style sandals; jewellery limited to a thin gold necklace with a small conch pendant, a pair of modest round gold earrings, and a single broad gold bangle on the right wrist, all refined but not ostentatious to emphasize servant-king humility.
appearance.signature: A long, slender golden broom (chera pahara broom) with a polished gold handle and tightly bound, pale straw bristles, held respectfully in both hands as if about to sweep, symbolizing his role as Lord Jagannath’s servant.

ref_desc: The Gajapati Servant King is a late-30s Odia ruler with medium-brown complexion, oval face, short beard, black topknot under a cream-and-gold turban, wearing a cream angarkha, deep-red dhoti, golden-yellow shawl, modest gold jewellery, and holding a slender golden broom.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of the Gajapati Servant King from Puri: a late-30s Odia man with medium-brown skin, an oval face, sharp cheekbones, calm serious eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; his black hair is tied in a compact topknot at the back, with sides closely trimmed, and he wears a cream-and-gold embroidered turban (pagri) wrapped low with a small lotus-shaped gold ornament at the forehead. Dress him in a knee-length cream cotton angarkha-style tunic with wrapped front, narrow red edging, and subtle woven diamond motifs, over a deep-red silk dhoti pleated in front and wrapped to the ankles with a simple gold border, and drape a broad golden-yellow silk uttariya from his left shoulder across his torso and over his right arm, its edges marked by maroon floral patterns. Add brown leather mojari-style sandals, a thin gold necklace with a small conch pendant, modest round gold earrings, and a single broad gold bangle on the right wrist, keeping the jewellery refined but not overly elaborate. Place a long slender golden broom with a polished handle and pale straw bristles in his hands, held respectfully as if ready to sweep, and use cream, deep red, golden yellow, brown, and black as the dominant colours to emphasize his dignified yet humble servant-king presence.
